HEADLINE: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation

blog.headline: Wayve’s $85M Tender Offer: Rethinking Employee Liquidity Before IPO
blog.angle: Wayve’s move to offer $85M in employee liquidity highlights the tension between employee cash needs and preserving control, showing founders how pre-IPO tender offers can retain top talent without sacrificing long-term incentives.

linkedin.headline: The best AI engineers don’t want to wait five years for a payday—and now, they don’t have to.
linkedin.angle: When startups stall on exits, offering employee liquidity through tender offers can keep top talent engaged and reduce turnover risk.

instagram.headline: Liquidity Isn’t Just for Founders
